2026_01_CLE_JAX.headline: Cleveland’s rebuilt offense faces Jacksonville’s continuity advantage
2026_01_CLE_JAX.paragraph1: Cleveland opens a new chapter under Todd Monken with Deshaun Watson returning from his Achilles injury, while Jacksonville brings back a largely intact staff and core after winning the AFC South. The Browns’ offensive line has undergone changes, making protection against Josh Hines-Allen and Jacksonville’s front an immediate concern. Trevor Lawrence has the benefit of system continuity, but Cleveland’s defensive front can shorten the game if it creates pressure without sacrificing run fits. Sacks and early-down efficiency should determine which offense stays on schedule.
2026_01_CLE_JAX.model_rationale: Jacksonville owns the steadier offensive environment, while Cleveland’s upset path depends on protecting Watson, avoiding negative plays and creating enough defensive pressure to disrupt Lawrence’s rhythm.
